--- message[0] role=user ---
Advise how to develop this character's talents. First assess the current layout (split, learned) in a sentence or two. Then give the order of the next 5-10 points, starting with those with canBuyNow, with a short justification from the talent description. Finally propose a target layout for the maximum level. Forever trees differ from classic ones: rely on the descriptions (description) in the data, and when you do not know a talent from classic, do not make up what it does. Take the play style into account (solo/questing vs. dungeons), and if it is unknown, ask about it at the end.

Answer in the language the user writes in; keep the names of spells, items, quests and places in English, as they appear in the game. Rely on the data below; if something is missing from it, say which window the player should open in game and then type /mcp reload. You only advise: do not propose macros or addons that play for the player.
